items.headline: David McComb leads Miami (Ohio) to 24-21 victory over UConn
items.description: — David McComb threw for 312 yards and two touchdowns and added a rushing score as Miami (Ohio) rallied from a 14-point deficit to beat Connecticut 24-21 on Saturday.

items.headline: American Conference not pursuing expansion, but 3 interested
items.description: The American Conference issued a statement Friday saying it is "not proactively" seeking to expand. Sources told ESPN that Miami (Ohio), James Madison and UConn have approached the conference about potentially joining.

items.headline: Nebraska, Miami (OH) '27 season to open at Arrowhead Stadium
items.description: Nebraska and Miami (OH) have moved their 2027 season opener to Arrowhead Stadium on Aug. 27, after they were forced to reschedule when the NCAA made calendar changes allowing schools to start their season a week earlier.
